$comment: Phase 23 (0.2.3) build-coverage-and-release-evidence-integrity scope gate and evidence record. Machine-readable source of truth for plans/023-Release-0-2-3-Build-Coverage-And-Release-Evidence-Integrity.md: the four 0.2.3 implementation items (build serialization; corrected workspace coverage denominators; machine-auditable release skip manifest; stabilized quality gates) each with task ownership and evidence tokens, the compat policy (version-literal-only at 0.2.3 — reviewed plain gate deltas: the version literal alone, after restoring the ag-ui acp/index.ts type re-export statements to the frozen value-style shape; no removal, no declaration change; baselines regenerated with --update-baseline, no --allow-break), the protected-gate policy (durable state-concurrency legs and the release skip manifest: required surfaces with absent evidence record blocked and fail the release gate, never passing skips; the 33 protected/live skips are named), per-task evidence tokens, and the deviation log. This is a scope gate, NOT a release-contract support matrix; the 0.1.x support matrix stays frozen at scripts/phase12-freeze-manifest.json. Baseline evidence for the Task 6 exit gate lives in scripts/phase23-baseline.json (green: true, blocked: false, captured 2026-08-14 at the 0.2.3 working-tree state).
baseline: 0.2.2 (plan 022 exit gate passed 2026-08-13; signed tag v0.2.2; 50 publishable manifests; audit 0; compat baselines current at 0.2.2; two remaining integrity gaps: concurrent emitters can expose partial live dist (build-clean race only partially fixed in 0.1.1) and workspace coverage rows include imported core dist (wrong denominator); 33 protected/live skips not machine-named in release summaries; Biome 2.x deprecated config + 97 lint diagnostics + load-sensitive timing asserts; HEAD 3126fc2)

compat.promise: VERSION-LITERAL-ONLY at 0.2.3. Plain reviewed gate at 0.2.3 before --update-baseline: the only delta is the version literal (changed: version on @arnilo/prism). The Task 4 useExportType fix had changed the ag-ui acp/index.ts type re-export statements to `export type` form, which the compat-surface parser keys differently (`type Name` garbage keys vs clean names) and read as removals; the statements were restored to the frozen value-style shape with biome-ignore + justification, so the 0.2.2 baseline holds byte-for-byte apart from the version literal. docs/migration.md gains the 0.2.2 -> 0.2.3 no-migration stub (the gate requires the version note; the section documents no runtime contract delta and store-safe rollback). No removal, no --allow-break.

deviations.change: Root npm test's script-gate segment (22 phase*-conformance/security/freeze .test.mjs files importing dist) is wrapped by the build lock (Option 2), superseding the earlier 'gate segment unwrapped' residual; scripts/phase23-build-race.test.mjs runs unwrapped in its own separate node --test invocation after the wrapped gates so its lock tests acquire the real lock.
deviations.rationale: The wrapped-gate run had made phase23 inherit PRISM_BUILD_LOCK_HELD=1 and a dead-pid lockfile leftover caused EEXIST in the live-lock test; separating the stress suite keeps the gate segment protected and the lock tests truthful.

deviations.change: All spawned children (with-build-lock runChild, coverage-summary runCoverage, phase23-build-race run, phase23-security spawn) strip NODE_TEST_CONTEXT/NODE_TEST_WORKER_ID.
deviations.rationale: node --test leaks those vars into spawned children and a nested node --test under that env silently runs zero tests and exits 0 (recursive run() warning), which made importer assertions vacuous and the fail-closed test false-green.

deviations.change: protectedException set finalized at session-store-postgres, enterprise-postgres, memory, session-store-nats (memory added beyond the Task 0 freeze).
deviations.rationale: memory's workspace coverage glob includes postgres-memory.integration.test.js, an env-gated durable leg that skips without PRISM_TEST_POSTGRES_URL; provider packages gated by PRISM_LIVE_PROVIDER_TESTS stay threshold-gated because offline conformance tests cover their mapping code and protecting all 10 would gut the gate.

deviations.change: Per-package threshold = min of two back-to-back byte-identical post-fix coverage runs minus 3pp (lines hard-gated; branches/functions recorded at observed min for reporting only).
deviations.rationale: phase22-baseline.json has no per-workspace rows to compare against, so the freeze capture is the first post-fix evidence; 3pp margin absorbs runner noise while 87.25 (mcp) still fails if the include filter breaks.

deviations.change: Canary rows name the implemented canaries (provider OIDC/OPA, MCP, A2A, web/Brave) not the plan's names (OIDC/OPA, S3, MCP-AS, NATS JetStream); canaries always record protected with reason, never pass and never blocked.
deviations.rationale: scripts/live-canary.mjs implements provider/mcp/a2a/web with PRISM_CANARY_* and PRISM_BRAVE_SEARCH_TOKEN envs; canary envs are always absent in release CI so blocking would make every release impossible.

deviations.change: The manifest keeps a 'test:nats real JetStream legs' protected-gap surface with requiredEnv PRISM_TEST_NATS_URL even though no source references that env; skip attribution is by class with the 33-skip aggregate on the core row.
deviations.rationale: node --test does not emit per-test-name skip reasons machine-readably; the real-leg expansion is roadmap 0.3.0.

deviations.change: Machine-readable lint report uses --reporter=sarif (--reporter-file=scripts/lint-report.sarif), not the plan text's --reporter=json; format:check stays exit-code-only.
deviations.rationale: Task 0 froze the sarif deviation; Biome's json reporter is experimental.

deviations.change: Biome 2.5.5 --unsafe noUnusedVariables renames side-effecting unused declarations to _-prefixed names instead of removing them; all 10 were removed by hand; no quarantine suite file was created.
deviations.rationale: Only one genuinely load-sensitive assert existed (mcp bridge 150ms bound), replaced by a deterministic barrier; the other guards carry documented ponytail: ceilings or use the sanctioned budgets.json envelope.

deviations.change: Packed matrix item 12 cannot run coverage-summary.mjs inside the consumer (tarballs exclude tests and scripts/ — no coverage surface by construction), so the packed journey asserts the single-shared-core copy + no dist/__tests__ artifacts walk, and the source-level T2 carries the runtime denominator proof.
deviations.rationale: The tarball exclusion is itself the point: no test artifacts can enter a packed coverage denominator.

deviations.change: The reserved phase23-baseline.json carries the 0.2.2 exitGate.counts forward (release: '0.2.3-reserved', green: false, blocked: true) until Task 6 records real evidence.
deviations.rationale: The release skip manifest reads the LATEST phase*-baseline.json; an empty reservation would record the core row blocked.

deviations.change: ag-ui acp/index.ts type re-export statements restored from `export type {...} from` to the value-style `export { type X, ... } from` form with biome-ignore + justification (Task 4's useExportType fix had changed the statement shape).
deviations.rationale: The compat-surface parser keys per-name type modifiers literally ('type AcpConfigOption'), so the statement-shape change read as 6 removed exports; restoring the frozen shape keeps the 0.2.3 compat delta to the version literal alone.

deviations.change: docs/migration.md gains a 0.2.2 -> 0.2.3 no-migration stub section.
deviations.rationale: The compat gate requires a migration.md mention of the release version for any changed delta (here: the version literal); the stub documents no runtime contract delta and store-safe rollback, honoring the plan's no-runtime-section intent.

deviations.change: scripts/phase23-skip-manifest.test.mjs runEmitter no longer re-spreads process.env over the caller's env copy.
deviations.rationale: `{...process.env, ...env}` resurrected keys the caller deleted from env, so blocked-not-skip recorded pass whenever the ambient env had PRISM_TEST_POSTGRES_URL (sdk:ready with the protected profile); the env parameter is now the authoritative full child env.
